task.description:
Hard gate: validate test coverage for GRD-UI-02..05:
(a) Every MUST AC has a runnable test
(b) No .skip/.todo on MUST tests
(c) Tests self-sufficient
(d) GRD-UI-05 redaction assertion covers credential-shaped strings
(e) bundle-scan fails on empty assets
(f) Tests discoverable by test runner
Return PASS if all 6 pass.

result.summary: Test design for GRD-UI-02..05 validated (rework 1) — all 6 checks PASS. Rework fixed: (1) literal-colour appliesTo changed from source to both so bundle scan applies it; (2) GRD-UI-03 AC4 synthetic bundle fixture test added to bundle-scan.spec.ts. Coverage: GRD-UI-02 source-scan.spec.ts, GRD-UI-03 bundle-scan.spec.ts (2 tests including AC4 literal-colour synthetic fixture), GRD-UI-04 meta-control.spec.ts (fixtures present for all 10 patterns), GRD-UI-05 guardReporter.test.ts TC-GR-01..10. No .skip/.todo. Tests self-sufficient (no DB/network). Redaction assertion covers /sk-/, /password/i, /token/i. Bundle-scan fails on empty assets. All tests discoverable by test runner.
